title: ಚೆನ್ನಬಸವಣ್ಣನ ವಚನಗಳು
author: ಚೆನ್ನಬಸವಣ್ಣ
description: ಕಲ್ಯಾಣದ ಅನುಭವಮಂಟಪದ ಶಿವಶರಣ ಚೆನ್ನಬಸವಣ್ಣನವರ ೨೯ ಆಯ್ದ ವಚನಗಳು — ಆಚಾರ-ಕಾಯಕ, ಗುರು-ಲಿಂಗ-ಜಂಗಮ, ಡಾಂಭಿಕ ಪೂಜೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜಾತಿ-ವೇದಾಭಿಮಾನದ ವಿಡಂಬನೆ. ಅಂಕಿತ: ಕೂಡಲಚೆನ್ನಸಂಗಮದೇವ.

provenance.licenseNote: Chennabasavanna (ಚೆನ್ನಬಸವಣ್ಣ) died in the Kalyana upheaval c. 1167–1196 (authorDied 1196). Text is public domain worldwide. Taken from the Kannada Wikisource edition: the author index page above links one page per vachana; the exact pages used are listed in sources.txt. Only the vachana text was taken; line breaks re-flowed at sentence ends where the import had split lines at commas. Other 12th-century sharanas do not yet have 15+ proofread individual vachana pages on kn.wikisource, so this is a single-author selection, not an anthology.
